column1: # U6: full Bitwarden (desktop app, bw CLI actions, SSH agent). Format: see the header of ~/.config/hub/hub.

column9: Official desktop app (Electron, native Wayland through ~/.config/electron39-flags.conf). Waybar vault module: middle click. Needed for the SSH agent.

Name, username, URI and a generated password become a new login (bw create item). The password is copied (sensitive, cleared in 30 s) and rbw is synced. Asks for the master password once per login (CLI session).
Presets or custom length; the result goes to the clipboard as sensitive and is cleared after 30 s. Needs no unlock.
Pick a login, rbw edit opens it in $EDITOR (first line = password, the rest = notes). Name, username and URI: use the desktop app.
Pick a login, then an old password; Enter copies it (sensitive, cleared in 30 s).
Creates a Send (default: deleted after 1 day, optional access limit and password) and copies the link. The link is meant to be shared, so it is copied as normal text.
Pick a file from fd results (or type a path), same options as the text Send, the link is copied.
Items with attachments only; the chosen file is saved into ~/Downloads (never overwrites).
Pick an item and a file; the file is uploaded as an attachment of that item.
Soft delete: the item goes to the Bitwarden trash. You must type its exact name to confirm.
Opens the official CLI session now (master password through pinentry). The other CLI rows do this on demand; it is dropped at lock and at every login.
Opens your server's web vault (the URL is read from the rbw config at run time).

ON = new shells use the desktop app's SSH agent socket while it exists (otherwise the current agent) and the app is started to the tray at login. Keys live in the vault: app > New > SSH key. Check with ssh-add -L.
